exposure: Controls (mothers who delivered through vaginal birth)
cohort: 396 mothers who gave birth at Mama Lucy Kibaki Hospital in Nairobi city county, Kenya (132 cases who delivered via CS and 264 controls who delivered vaginally)
finding: Employment status and birth weight were associated with CS in urban Kenyan mothers.
mod_finding: Mothers whose babies had a normal birth weight (≥ 2.5kg) were less likely to undergo CS compared to mothers whose babies had a low birth weight.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a factor, but specific weight categories not provided
